subject: Security assessment evidence: sanitization guidelines & NDA for report access
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@veridian.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire.huang@veridian.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: assessment exec summary + report access (NDA/filters)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Veridian's security and procurement teams are moving quickly. We need two things to progress: a sanitized executive summary of the most recent security assessment and guidance on what will be required to share the full penetration test report.

High-level asks:
- Can you provide an executive summary we can circulate to our InfoSec committee (no vendor-sensitive exploit traces)?
- What NDA or access controls do you require before Redwood can share the full report or sample findings?
- Do you support a sanitization matrix (PII removal, exploit repro steps redacted, anonymize tester IDs)?

We have an external assessor (ThirdWing Security) and can sign an NDA quickly — please let us know the preferred routing.

Appreciate a note on remediation status for high/critical findings as well (we just need a short status column we can pass to procurement).

Best,
Samir
Director of Vendor Risk
Veridian Financial Services

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@veridian.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: assessment exec summary + report access (NDA/filters)

Samir — thanks for the clear list. I'm looping in Laura (legal) and Marissa (Security Ops) to confirm the gating steps. In the meantime I've attached a short executive summary (sanitized draft) you can use with the committee. It's intentionally high level — no exploit PoCs, only findings and remediation status.

Quick notes:
- We require a signed mutual NDA before full report exchange.
- For third-party assessors (e.g., ThirdWing) we prefer them to receive the same sanitized samples unless they execute our data handling addendum.
- Laura will share the sanitization matrix we use for disclosure (what we remove vs what we keep).

Next steps: Laura, can you confirm the NDA template and redaction rules? Marissa, can you provide the remediation status snapshot for high/critical items? Samir — once the signed NDA is in place we'll produce a redacted sample of report pages (see timeline below).

Attachments: veridian_exec_summary_v1.pdf (sanitized executive summary, draft)

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@veridian.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: assessment exec summary + report access (NDA/filters)

Hi Samir — Jordan, thanks for the intro.

We can proceed under a mutual NDA. For efficiency we use a short mutual agreement plus a data handling addendum for third-party assessors. Key points on sanitization:
- Executive summary: redact exploit PoCs, IP-level attack chains that would enable replication, specific tester session IDs, and any customer PII. Keep impact, likelihood, and remediation guidance intact.
- Full report: provided under NDA with a sanitized sample of findings (one or two full findings with technical detail removed). If ThirdWing needs full detail for verification, they must sign the data handling addendum; otherwise we provide sanitized excerpts.
- We maintain an internal redaction matrix; attached is a starting version (redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx). Please review and confirm any additional items you want sanitized.

Timelines:
- Signed NDA received by EOD 2026-09-15 -> sanitized sample within 48 business hours (we aim earlier).
- If addendum required for ThirdWing -> countersignature window ~3 business days.

Marissa, can you provide a remediation status table focused on high/critical items for Veridian?

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@veridian.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire.huang@veridian.com>, ThirdWing Security <info@thirdwingsec.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: assessment exec summary + report access (NDA/filters)

Thanks Laura — attaching the countersigned mutual NDA (signed_nondisclosure_veridian_20260915.pdf). We've also noted the redaction matrix and propose two clarifications:
1) We need anonymized attack timeline entries (date ranges OK) so our ops can correlate with internal logs.
2) For remediation status, a short column labelled "Can confirm internally" (yes/no) would help procurement.

ThirdWing is happy to sign the data handling addendum; Claire (cc'd) will follow up on their signature.

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync on 2026-09-17 to walk the sanitized sample and remediation table?

—Samir

Attachment: signed_nondisclosure_veridian_20260915.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@veridian.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@veridian.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: assessment exec summary + report access (NDA/filters)

Samir / Claire — appreciated, and thanks for the signed NDA. Per Laura's routing we've prepared the following and attached them to this message:
- sanitized executive summary (veridian_exec_summary_v1.pdf) — the version we shared earlier with two clarifying edits, now final for your committee;
- redaction matrix (redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx) — includes our anonymization rules (dates -> week ranges);
- sample_findings_sanitized.txt — one high and one critical finding with technical details removed and an added "Can confirm internally" column for your ops.

Marissa: remediation snapshot included for high/critical items (shared internally) — summary line included in the exec summary and the sample_findings_sanitized.txt.

Next:
- If ThirdWing signs the addendum, we can provide an expanded sample (additional findings) for their review.
- Let's confirm the 2026-09-17 10:00 AM ET slot for the 30-min walk-through — Claire, does that work?

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: veridian_exec_summary_v1.pdf, redaction_matrix_v1.xlsx, sample_findings_sanitized.txt
